# Northstar Components Q2 Call

## Manufacturing capacity

Northstar installed two production lines at its Brno plant. The lines increase annual unit output by thirty percent.

## Gross margin

Higher plant utilization reduces unit conversion costs. Management expects this operating leverage to add two margin points next year.

## Outlook

Management kept the annual revenue forecast unchanged. Demand from automotive customers remains stable.
